name: Earth Girl
source:
What is this place...? What is this... this monster...?

A short, kinetic novel about feeling isolated and alone in new surroundings. It's approx 1,100 words so will last you around 10mins. It was written and created entirely in one day!
translation:
这里是什么地方……？

这个……怪物又是什么……？

一部讲述在陌生环境中感到孤立与孤独的短篇动能小说。全文约1100词，游玩时间约10分钟。作品完全在一天内写成并制作完成！
